measurement.memory_events:
low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0
measurement.memory_scope: cgroup memory.peak includes charged page cache/kernel memory; summed process RSS double-counts shared pages and sampled peak is a lower bound; neither is falsely called exact aggregate RSS
measurement.CPU_scope: cgroup cpu.stat counts all descendants including exited/reaped forked stages; parent sampler is outside workload cgroup
measurement.observer_scope: Observer is outside workload cgroup but competes on the same one guest CPU. Wall time includes its contention; differing process counts can change observer cost. No overhead subtraction.

IO.scope: cgroup io.stat is guest virtual-block accounting, not host physical-media I/O; cached reads and delayed writeback may show zero. Logical lower bound is the MAXIMUM observed individual /proc counter across PID/start-time records, NOT their sum: ancestor counters include waited descendants and summing histories double-counts. This conservative maximum can omit siblings, short-lived/reaped processes and post-last-sample work; it is not complete logical tree traffic. Waited block accounting is separate. No fsync or cache manipulation added to real trials.
IO.sentinel_scope: Tiny C child-subreaper waits direct and orphaned descendants, then reads its inclusive Linux /proc/self/io counters. Delta covers command tree plus sentinel setup/self-read overhead; metadata-line write occurs afterward. No overlapping ancestor sum. CPU/RSS/wall/cgroup counters include identical sentinel and metadata emission in both lanes, with no subtraction. Not application-only logical I/O or host physical-media traffic.

disk.scope: Regular files in trial cwd only, symlinks and external raw targets excluded. Total workspace includes precreated wrapper/recipe. Temporary excludes baseline files and declared final output. Logical size and st_blocks*512 allocated bytes are distinct. Sampled peaks are LOWER BOUNDS; transient create/delete between polls is missed. Output/log files outside cwd not counted here.

summary.A: NMRPipe13 exact original conversion/processing plus pipe2ucsf for UCSF
summary.B: SpinFlow native float32 CLI, one thread,1GiB array budget
limitations: Single1vCPU WHPX guest on hostlogicalCPU2,4GiB guest; not baremetal or exclusive physical core. SMT sibling, hostload,thermal/power conditions uncontrolled.
Fixed7interleaved pairs, warm/cache-uncontrolled; no fsync/cachepurge/outlierdrop/overheadsubtraction. End-to-end command startup through final normal close included.
5ms observer shares guestCPU but outside workload cgroup. Its CPU is reported separately; differing process counts change observer cost. Tiny identical C sentinel is included in both workload lanes.
Summed process RSS double-counts shared pages and sampled peak is a lower bound. cgroup memory charge includes cache/kernel; it is not process RSS.
Waited-subreaper inclusive logical I/O includes tiny helper/self-read overhead. Guestvirtualblock counters are not hostphysicalmedia I/O and are affected by cache/delayedwriteback.
Workspace logical/allocated peaks are sampled lower bounds; temporary excludes pre-existing inputs/config and final output. External symlinks never followed. Final output bytes exact.
Full rawoutput SHA retained; same-lane identity excludes only sixPipe creationtimestamp fields or26UCSF creationtimestamp bytes. Every other header/payload byte exact.
